notes: «مؤذن مسجد جردان» is a description of Abdullah: left out
Ali speaks and asks inside Adisa's account («يا أبا مسلم ألا تعينني»): he is only in the scene; her father answers and relays the Prophet's charge, so «أبي» is the last link
«أبي» is her father, a relation; not merged with any name in the chain
